title: An Intervention on Healthy Adults of Probiotics on Gut Flora Metabolisms of Choline
brief_summary: The aim of the study is to examine the effects of probiotics intervention on choline metabolites and intestinal microbiota composition using a randomized double blind clinical trial. Also, we proposed to explore the real-time change of choline metabolites after probiotics intervention through a PC challenge test. Our study will clarify the biochemical pathway involved in metabolic diseases and hope to provide a new targeted-preventive and therapeutic strategy for chronic metabolic diseases.
